# Wonek Video Studio — Public Documentation & Technical Reference

> Native macOS AI video editor and short-form content studio running Whisper ASR, Qwen/Gemma LLMs, and Maya1 TTS locally on Apple Silicon alongside BYOK cloud API orchestration without per-minute credit lock-in.

## Publisher & Entity Provenance
- **Developer**: Arte Soft EOOD (https://arte-soft.com/)
- **Apple App Store Developer Profile**: https://apps.apple.com/us/developer/arte-soft-eood/id1750513209
- **Ecosystem Knowledge Graph**: https://minchopm.github.io/arte-soft-ecosystem/
- **GitHub Documentation Repository**: https://github.com/minchopm/wonek-video-studio-docs
- **GitHub Pages URL**: https://minchopm.github.io/wonek-video-studio-docs/
- **Platforms**: macOS 26+ (Apple Silicon & Mac Catalyst)
- **Last Verified**: 2026-11-10

## Verified Capabilities & Boundaries
- On-device Apple Silicon inference for Whisper speech recognition, Qwen/Gemma script refinement, and Maya1 neural text-to-speech.
- Auto Clips, translated burned-in Auto Subtitles, Bulk Video batch production, and integrated Thumbnail Studio.
- Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) direct connection to LTX, Google, and OpenAI media APIs stored locally in macOS Keychain.
- Multi-channel local workspace organization with direct YouTube publishing, zero ads, and technical workflow hubs on studio.wonek.com and wonek-video-studio.arte-soft.com.

## Canonical Web Hubs
- [Primary Website](https://studio.wonek.com/): Official product overview, features, and pricing.
- [Arte Soft Portal](https://wonek-video-studio.arte-soft.com/): Expanded multilingual guides, comparisons, and technical references.
- [Apple App Store](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/wonek-video-studio/id6761376446?mt=12): Official App Store listing by Arte Soft EOOD.
- [Side-by-Side Comparisons](https://studio.wonek.com/compare): Structured HTML & GFM comparison matrices.
- [Guides & Workflows](https://studio.wonek.com/guides): Step-by-step operational guides.
- [Full Site LLM Reference](https://studio.wonek.com/llms-full.txt): Complete GFM Markdown table export.
